title: AutoGPT
before: Agent loops were research prototypes described in papers.
problem: Nobody had packaged one so that an ordinary developer could run it against a goal.
breakthrough: An open loop that plans, calls tools, writes files and recurses until a goal is met, using GPT-4.
why: It made autonomous agents a mainstream idea, and its unreliability taught the field what was actually hard.
next: The sober descendants are today's coding agents with tight scopes and verification.
inherits: Public expectations about agents, both the enthusiasm and the scepticism.
